visualCharacteristics.description: Centered uppercase tab labels with active underline; each panel is a horizontal product slider (5 visible, arrows and dots) of image, name and price.

contentPattern.description: Tabbed product recommendations: tabs TRENDING / TOP SELLERS / MOST POPULAR; each panel is a horizontal product slider (image, product name, list/sale price, link to product page) with prev/next arrows and dots

usage: Featured products: tabs (Trending, Top Sellers, Most Popular), each panel a horizontal product slider with arrows and dots.
